scenes.title: Companion for Mentra glasses
scenes.caption: Glasses voice in, your own AI out.
scenes.narration: Mentra glasses voice input, answered by the AI you run, and spoken back.

scenes.title: Speak. Your stack answers. It speaks back.
scenes.caption: Voice becomes a model response, then audio.
scenes.narration: Your voice becomes a response from the model you configure, and the answer is spoken back.

scenes.title: Wired to the stack you own.
scenes.caption: Sign in, route to your models, add Memory.
scenes.narration: You sign in with your Companion Intelligence account. Inference routes to your Companion Hub, or to Hermes and OpenClaw endpoints. Memory is optional.
